formulations.Polymer system Notes: Poly(AN-co-BuA) copolymers with varying AN content (50-83 mol%) and various lithium salts (LiI, LiN(CF3SO2)2, LiClO4, LiAlCl4, LiCF3SO3, LiBF4) at molar ratios of 1.2 or 2.0 relative to AN monomeric units.
formulations.Transference notes: indicate an increased participation of cations in the electrical charge conduction and a different conduction mechanism compared to that of classical electrolytes based on complexes with polyethers
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Not explicitly stated in text, derived from Arrhenius fit at low T
formulations.Notes: Solvents were dried and distilled in an argon atmosphere prior to use. Electrolytes were obtained by casting from polymer and salt solution in acetonitrile. All operations were carried out in an atmosphere of dried argon.
